en: If it's about our work, do come back by day.
Do come and talk to me later.
I'll be at the Charity Society headquarters.
Oh my, it's you again.
I thought you might be busy?
Your work seems to leave you rather free.
Ah, it's you.
We do see each other often. Your visits are
always welcome.
As one gets older, one's friends grow fewer.
I'd truly like someone as fine as you to join
our Charity Society.
Do come again.
Oh my, what brings you here so late at night?
I was sorting the papers for our projects.
I shall have you lend me a hand.
It is nothing difficult. It will soon be over.
Whatever do you mean?
...You are to become my servant.

en: Ngh,

en: Nngaaah!
That makes one more......
A lovely morning, isn't it?
I'm afraid I'm no good in the mornings, so if
it's lovely or not, I can't really tell...
Good evening. Can I help you?
Forgive me for asking, but do you have work?
Yes, well, more or less...
Oh, I see. That's very good of you.
I'm sorry, but I do have work.
Good evening. We do keep meeting.
<I can't say>

en: <A detective of sorts>
note: choice; leads to #5395 'I thought as much... heard you were looking into things in town'

en: I meant no harm, so please forgive me.
note: no used_in: Bruce, third line after #5392/#5393 (reply to <I can't say>)

en: Oh, no, that's not it. Sorry.
I was just wondering what you do here,
and I got curious, that's all...
I've only just moved to London.
Right now, I'm planning to build a park.
I want a park where all can relax and children
can play safely, full of trees and greenery.
It's painful, turning humans into my servants
like this, just for my own purposes.
Especially taking someone like you,
someone who can care for others,
away from the human world...
But I have no other choice.

en: None at all...
Because, whatever it takes,
I have to stop him...
Oh,
note: name + #0 ', my master...' follows (rule from report 000)

en: What is your wish?
I've looked pale lately, and I'm getting thin.
Come, grant me your orders...
Garlic dishes, which I always used to love,
I just can't bring myself to eat anymore.
Fancy my tastes changing at my age.
Hmph. And who might you be?
Do you want something?
I merely thought I'd at least greet you,
that's all.
Hmph. Perhaps that's wise.
If you know I'm London councillor Norman
and greet me as such, then all well and good.
(Hmph. A greedy, arrogant-looking man...)
What is it? I'm in a hurry.
Hmph, we meet again. Good morning.
I'm pondering something important, so I've
no time to talk with you, I'm afraid.
Hmm, so it's you. Good morning.
You've been seen in all sorts of places lately,
note: followed by #5512 'so I hear.' or #3405 'it seems.' (msg 226762)

en: so I hear.
If city affairs interest you, I could put in a
word for you. You seem to come from a good
family; you'd lend the city office some class.
And who might you be?
I don't recall knowing anyone like you.
Hmph, you're an odd one.
I've no time to bother with you, you know.
